\item \textbf{Grid-Line Leading-Digit Truncation on 3-Digit Tallies ( 10.87% of errors):} On 5 cells for major parties (\texttt{A} and \texttt{APC}), the Presiding Officer wrote a 3-digit score starting with \texttt{1} right on top of the left vertical border of the score box.

\item \textbf{ 95.65% Automatic Detection via Section 64(4) and the Biro Party-Alteration Discovery:} Every single Sparse-Row Omission ( 29/29 ), Grid-Line Truncation ( 5/5 ), Stroke Substitution ( 8/8 ), and Full-Row Dropout ( 2/2 ) breaks the sum rule \sum_p \hat{v}_{i,p} = \hat{V}_{\text{valid}, i} and gets caught immediately by the Section 64(4) Collation Sum Gate ( 44/46 = 95.65% ).
